decision: Recommend blocker-owned reversible pruning as the next isolated revision; no template redesign or cap increase justified yet
scope: Completed throwaway diagnostic only; no algorithm change or production promotion
rejected_hypothesis: Earlier seven choices alone exhaust hydrogen. Exhaustive replay instead found25 survivors; stone is a necessary member of the final blocking core.

root_cause.location: template_paths.select candidate/remove and chronological trail rollback, lines641-645 and681-686 in the frozen source
root_cause.mechanism: Rejections discovered while a deeper decision is active are restored with that decision even when their actual conflicting selected candidate belongs to an unchanged ancestor. These candidates are decoded and checked again on sibling branches.
root_cause.evidence: One unchanged seven-decision prefix;30,500 repeated decodes of candidates independently shown blocked by that prefix; all eight tried stone candidates block its25 surviving hydrogen candidates.

recommendation.change: Associate each dynamic deletion with its actual blocking selected-candidate assignment, and restore only when that assignment is removed or replaced. Keep static deletions permanent.
recommendation.invariant: A dynamic candidate stays deleted only while its exact blocker assignment remains selected; assignment generations must prevent stale explanations after backtracking. Store one witnessed conflict, not an unbounded collection.
